retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: a robbery of the Banco Nacional Ultramarino at Malveira on 6 October 1980. The atlas holds no record of the armed far left — not the PRP-BR, not the FP-25, not the trials — so there is nothing for an action of theirs to attach to in either direction, and any edge would be invented. Revisit once the organisations themselves are here.
